import glom
from glom import Call, T

# Patch Call.glomit to see what's happening
orig_glomit = Call.glomit
def debug_glomit(self, target, scope):
    print(f'Call.glomit called with target={target!r}')
    print(f'  self.func={self.func}')
    print(f'  self.args={self.args!r}')
    print(f'  type(self.args)={type(self.args)}')
    return orig_glomit(self, target, scope)

Call.glomit = debug_glomit

list_target = ['hello', 'world']
print('Result:', glom(list_target, Call(str.upper)))
"
